lines.caption: This is a tour of pull request 110, which runs a local code review at high, with fixes, before the first push.
lines.say: This is a tour of pull request one ten, which runs a local code review at high, with fixes, before the first push.

lines.caption: It has three parts: what the PR adds, how it was checked, and how it will be measured.
Part 1. What this PR adds.
One new rule in CLAUDE.md replaces the hand-briefed local review, and two skills now point to it.
First, the main session commits its work, because the review reads only committed changes.
Then it starts a fresh general-purpose agent, which hasn't seen the conversation.
The agent runs the code-review skill at high, with fixes, on the branch's changes, leaving the explainers out.
It reports only what it fixed, and the skipped findings as S1, S2 and so on, each with a recommended fix.
lines.say: It reports only what it fixed, and the skipped findings as S one, S two and so on, each with a recommended fix.

lines.caption: Back in the main session, it reads the diff and undoes any fix it can't confirm.
The rest goes into the first push, and CI's own review at high follows as before.
Each finding CI confirms costs another push and review; pull request 108 took 10 review rounds and 45 findings.
lines.say: Each finding C I confirms costs another push and review; pull request one oh eight took ten review rounds and forty-five findings.

lines.caption: The local agent uses CI's skill and level, but knows only the branch, so it judges the diff on its own.
The prompt names only the target and the return format, and nobody edits the files while the agent runs.
It diffs against GitHub's main, never a local main that can be stale.
Its report uses the format CLAUDE.md already asks for after a code review with fixes.
The local fixer also applies findings it isn't sure of, unlike CI, so the main session checks each one.
The rule lives in CLAUDE.md, and the explainer and batch skills now refer to it.
Here is the new rule, shortened, as it reads in CLAUDE.md's Context section.
The PR changes CLAUDE.md and two skills, and adds this page and its narration.
To undo it, revert the PR, and sessions go back to the old review that only lists findings.
Part 2. How it was built and verified.
The rule was run on this PR itself; Thunar's build doesn't apply, and the savings are measured later.
It follows CI's review level, pull request 108's numbers, and CLAUDE.md's format for skipped findings.
lines.say: It follows C I's review level, pull request one oh eight's numbers, and CLAUDE.md's format for skipped findings.

lines.caption: Before the first push, a fresh agent ran the review at high on this branch: 9 findings, 3 fixed.
lines.say: Before the first push, a fresh agent ran the review at high on this branch: nine findings, three fixed.

lines.caption: The skill started no reviewer agents of its own, so it runs fine inside a subagent.
The review took about 71k tokens and two minutes.
lines.say: The review took about seventy-one thousand tokens and two minutes.

lines.caption: A local main diff covered 120 files, against 2 for GitHub's main.
lines.say: A local main diff covered a hundred and twenty files, against two for GitHub's main.

lines.caption: Thunar's build and tests weren't run, since the PR changes only docs and skills.
This page was rendered and its narration stamped; CI's jobs hadn't run yet.
The local review at high found 9 findings; the agent fixed 3 and skipped 6.
lines.say: The local review at high found nine findings; the agent fixed three and skipped six.

lines.caption: It fixed the diff base, left the explainers out, and pointed the batch brief to the new rule.
The main session then fixed three skipped ones: undo unconfirmed fixes, and commit before the review.
Three were left: one on purpose, one low-value, and one about this page, now written.
CI's own review comes after the first push, in the code review comment on pull request 110.
lines.say: C I's own review comes after the first push, in the code review comment on pull request one ten.

lines.caption: Whether it saves CI rounds is measured on the next CI or script PR, against pull request 108.
lines.say: Whether it saves C I rounds is measured on the next C I or script pull request, against pull request one oh eight.

lines.caption: Batch sessions pick up the rule from main on the next batch run.
The issue, pull request 110 and pull request 108 are linked here.
lines.say: The issue, pull request one ten and pull request one oh eight are linked here.

lines.caption: Part 3. What comes later: measuring it.
No open issue builds on this one; the next CI or script PR measures it on real code.
This PR adds the local review rule.
The next CI or script PR runs it before its first push and records the local fixes.
Then its CI rounds and findings are compared with 10 and 45.
lines.say: Then its C I rounds and findings are compared with ten and forty-five.

lines.caption: That PR runs the local review and records what it fixed and skipped.
It counts CI's rounds and checks that the agent's report stays short.
In short: pull request 110 runs CI's review once locally, with fixes, before the first push.
lines.say: In short: pull request one ten runs C I's review once locally, with fixes, before the first push.
